reviewer: Specialist: life_safety, accessibility, acoustics_av (other disciplines not scored)
weighted_score_note: Weighted over the three assigned disciplines only (15/10/10, normalised to 35). Not comparable to a full nine-discipline score. Previous scores: B01 4.29, B02 5.71.

verification_of_iter02_responses.BOH_exit_passages: VERIFIED in the manifest. ARC-WALL-BOH-EXIT-W1/W2 (x 17.45-17.6 / 21.2-21.35) and E1/E2 (x 67.75-67.9 / 71.5-71.65) run from y 53.65 to 62.35, from the stage wall to the north wall, and give a 3.6 m clear passage from DR-STAGE-W/E straight to DR-EXT-BOH-W/E (3.36 m effective). ARC-WALL-BOH-CORRIDOR is cut at x 17.6-21.2 and 67.9-71.5. The corridor reaches each passage only through DR-BOH-X-W1/W2/E1/E2, which are 1.8 m doors (1.64 m clear) with Role 'Self-closing fire door'. Fire rating is TBC. EGR-09 passes.

verification_of_iter02_responses.cross_aisle_ramps: VERIFIED. ARC-RAMP-CROSS-W/E are 2.38 m wide, 1:12, 0.525 m rise and 6.3 m run. The ARC-STAIR-CROSS steps have been removed.
verification_of_iter02_responses.band_places: VERIFIED. The band places are now M02-M11 only (for example M02-01 centre about (18.8, 35.4)), which is within the 80 deg fan.
verification_of_iter02_responses.refuges: PRESENT but unprotected. ACC-REFUGE-L02-1/2 are at x 46.0-47.85, y 0.4-1.8, z 3.33, on the rear landing inside the hall.
verification_of_iter02_responses.acoustic_panels: PRESENT. ARC-ACOUSTIC-W/E-01..06 and -08 have AcousticRequirement 'NRC >= 0.8 or diffusers over >= 60 % of the concave rear wall', spanning z 3.73 to about 8.7-10.1. The two door facets (-07) are untreated.

findings.finding: This is a persistent weakness and was not addressed: two thirds of hall occupants still leave at +3.325 m and go down stairs (2,346 of 3,532, 66.4 %). Widening the side-foyer stairs only moved the bottleneck to the door. DR-HALL-ARC-W/E now carry 448 occupants each against exactly 3.36 m of capacity, so there is again zero margin.
findings.fix: Add grade exits in the side walls at the ends of the cross aisle, beside the cross-end ramp feet (about y 43-50). Aim for no more than about half of the occupants on stairs and at least 10 % spare capacity on every exit.

findings.finding: Travel distances have got worse with each iteration. 535 occupants are now beyond the 30 m in-hall placeholder flag (B01 406, B02 486), and the maximum is 45.4 m (B01 41.6, B02 43.73). The direct seat-to-exit maximum is 32.8 m and the mean 16.15 m, against Option A's 26.1 m and 13.26 m. B now does worse than A on the like-for-like direct measure, and has more occupants over the flag (535 vs 490).
findings.evidence: geometry_checks EGR-03 {max 45.4, over_flag 535}, EGR-03N {45.4, 459}; comparison.md direct seat-to-exit max 32.8 / mean 16.15 (A 26.1 / 13.26).
findings.fix: The same extra grade exits at the ends of the cross aisle would shorten the long side-block routes. Record the trend in open_issues and give the fire engineer the option of side-wall vomitories.

findings.finding: The BOH escape passages are now properly enclosed, which closes iter-01 B-CB-01 and iter-02 B02-LS-03. A few details remain. The DR-BOH-X fire doors are FireExit=False with 'Single/double swing (TBC)' and an unconfirmed rating. Staff in the BOH also depend on these doors (1.64 m clear) to reach the passages. The DR-STAGE-W/E Role text now matches the design.
findings.evidence: manifest DR-BOH-X-W1 props (EffectiveClearWidth 1.64, FireExit False, Operation 'Single/double swing (TBC)', Role 'Self-closing fire door...'); ARC-WALL-BOH-EXIT-* 'fire-resisting construction TBC'.
findings.fix: Mark DR-BOH-X-* as FireExit for staff and make them open in the direction of escape into the passage. Ask the fire engineer to set a rating for the passage enclosure.

findings.finding: The two L02 refuge spaces sit in the open hall on the rear landing, about 1-2 m from the head of the east foyer stair, where about 580 people pass (DR-HALL-S2). They have no enclosure, are not on a protected route, and have no communication. The status text admits this is not designed. They are also on the east side only.
findings.evidence: manifest ACC-REFUGE-L02-1/2 at x 46.0-47.85, y 0.4-1.8, z 3.33, Status 'protection / assisted evacuation not designed'; exit_schedule DR-HALL-S2 581.
findings.fix: Move the refuges outside the hall, onto the stair-head landings beyond DR-HALL-S1 and S2, out of the stair flow width. Treat the landing and stair as a protected stair if the fire engineer requires it, and add two-way communication.

findings.finding: All 60 wheelchair users and companions are still assigned only to the two stage-side exits. Those routes are now enclosed and step-free, but there is no assigned alternative if one is blocked, even though the front-corner grade exits are lightly loaded (129 and 66).
findings.evidence: geometry_checks ACC-08 value [DR-STAGE-E, DR-STAGE-W]; exit_schedule W-FRONT 129, E-FRONT 66.
findings.fix: Assign wheelchair users from the front places and the near band groups to the front-corner exits as well, and check the scenario where one stage exit is blocked.

findings.finding: The concave arc facets now carry modelled panels with a performance requirement, which deals with the focusing risk at concept level. Some parts of the rear wall are still bare. The door facets (-07) are untreated. The panels stop at about +8.7 to +10.1 m, below the raised roof. The central straight rear-wall section between the arcs (x about 24-56, including the booth front) has no treatment, yet it is a flat surface parallel to the stage wall about 52 m away, which risks a late echo of about 300 ms to the platform.
findings.evidence: manifest ARC-ACOUSTIC-W/E-01..06, -08 bbox (no -07; z max 8.69-10.13; x ranges 0.4-23.99 and 56.01-79.6); comparison.md hall volume 40,190 m3.
findings.fix: Extend the requirement (absorption NRC >= 0.8 or diffusion) to the central rear wall and booth front, to the door-facet heads, and up to the roof soffit.

findings.finding: Raising the roof increased the volume to 13.4 m3 per seat (40,190 m3), up from 10.05. This is still less than Option A's 16.6, but it gives up part of B's earlier acoustic advantage for amplified worship, and there is still no RT estimate. The 16 x 7 m main screen extends the 8H reach to 56 m. 1,564 seats rely on screens, and SGT-H1 still has no vertical-angle or obstruction check. There is still no loudspeaker coverage check.
findings.evidence: comparison.md volume 40,190 / 13.4 per seat; SRV-AV-SCREEN-MAIN-C x 32-48, z 5.9-12.9; SGT-H1 relying_on_screens 1564.
findings.fix: Commission an early RT estimate and set a target RT for amplified worship, with roof soffit absorption sized to meet it. Add vertical-angle checks to SGT-H1.

strengths: The stage-side exits now discharge through enclosed 3.6 m passages, from the stage wall straight to external doors, with self-closing fire doors to the BOH corridor. This is a clean protected-route concept.

All egress stairs have landings (at most 10 risers per flight) and adequate widths: 6.0 m foyer stairs with centre rails, 3.6 m side-foyer stairs, and 2.0 m ambulatory stairs leaving about 2.9 m clear beside them.

There is a full-width (2.38 m) 1:12 step-free route between the front corners, the cross aisle and the band. Wheelchair places are central at the front and kept within the fan in the band, and wheelchair users are kept on grade exits.
The acoustic focusing risk now has modelled panels with a stated performance requirement, and no occupant exceeds the 60 m total-travel placeholder.
Open issues and status text honestly mark fire ratings, refuge protection and acoustic design as TBC. No compliance is claimed.
limitations: The passages, corridor gaps, doors, refuges, ramps and panels were verified from the manifest vertices and properties. I did not rebuild the egress on a route graph or model fire or smoke. I did no RT or ray-trace modelling, so echo delays are first-order (distance / 343 m/s). I did not review the renders in detail. All width, riser and distance criteria are placeholders because no local code values are available. Option A was not re-reviewed (unchanged since iter-01).
certification_disclaimer: This is a concept-stage QA review score. It is not professional certification, fire/egress approval, accessibility audit, acoustic design or code-compliance confirmation; a qualified fire engineer, access consultant and acoustician must review the design under applicable Zimbabwean requirements.
